Lead profile: small-mid SaaS (developer tooling) building in-app help + knowledge search. Wants hosted API (self-serve) — low lift to get started. Primary contacts: Miguel Soto (CTO), Lana Park (Lead FE), Jordan Kim (SRE).

Integration asks (high priority):
- LangChain adapter examples (python) showing Redwood hosted API as LLM backend with streaming responses and tools. Need retriever integration (FAISS/Chroma), embedding example using Redwood embeddings endpoint, and demo of prefix caching + rate limits.
- LlamaIndex (aka GPT Index) quickstart: ingest docs -> create vector store -> query with LLM backend using Redwood hosted endpoint. Sample loader for markdown + Notion export.

- Model preference: open models preferred (Llama-family or MPT-like). Wants Redwood-verified suggestions for small-medium models and fallbacks.
- Routing/fallback: need a reliable fallback to a smaller model when quota/latency spikes.
- Security: SOC2 compliance helpful; audit logs required for later procurement. No on-prem or VPC needed for initial POC.
